description.en: Taiwan geographic name (台灣地名) is obtained from Taiwanese Open Data Platform. The dataset links are http://data.gov.tw/node/40281, http://data.gov.tw/node/40456, http://data.gov.tw/node/40454. This service aims to provide unique IDs for referencing Taiwan place names
